source_analysis.skill: Recognize a common angle in a difference of squared cosine and sine, extract any common coefficient, and express the result as a single scaled cosine of twice that angle.
reasoning_steps: Identify the shared argument and common coefficient.
Simplify the doubled argument and retain the external coefficient.
invariants: Both trigonometric terms share an argument and coefficient.
The assessed operation is expression rewriting rather than exact-value evaluation.
Necessary factoring and angle simplification appear in the worked solution.
The response is a complete scaled trigonometric ratio.
permitted_variations: Modest integer, rational and radical common factors.
Different correct positions and complete plausible error profiles.
Authored fourth-power differences reduced through difference-of-squares factoring and the known Pythagorean identity.
